channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: An angry driver in Arizona follows up a rear-end crash with a dangerous decision; two motorists clash over the right of way at a roundabout in Virginia; a luxury car collides with another vehicle at a calming island in England; a standoff in a St. Louis parking lot turns threatening; a fire erupts in a motorcycle repair shop in China; a sports car on a Los Angeles freeway appears to accept a speed challenge.
